title: Cotton Mulmul Handblock Saree
description:
Fabric : Cotton Mulmul saree handblock printed with natural dyes
Size : 6.5 mtr with blouse
washingTips:
This natural fibres are very soft, breathable and hence requires gentle approach towards the cloth to preserve their delicate weaves, natural dyes, and unique textures.

- Natural dyes may bleed in first wash
- Avoid drying in high sunlight area.
- Gentle wash with mild detergents,
- Avoid scrubbing and overnight soaking
